answer: Require every identity to publish, each epoch, a fresh original text embedding that round's challenge words - violet, wharf, sable - and have rotating agent juries grade it. Distinct high-quality reasoning can't be cloned: an attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must produce a thousand passing texts every single epoch. Cost grows linearly per fake identity while the epoch's emission stays fixed, so Sybil farming burns more work than it earns.
